title: Azure Blob

fields.name: account_name
fields.description: Azure Storage account name.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Specify the type to authenticate against the service. Supported values: key, sas.

fields.name: auto_create_container
fields.description: If container_name doesn't exist in the remote service, enabling this option handles the exception and auto-creates the container.

fields.name: azure_blob_buffer_key
fields.description: Set the Azure Blob buffer key which needs to be specified when using multiple instances of Azure Blob output plugin and buffering is enabled.

fields.name: blob_type
fields.description: Specify the desired blob type. Supported values: appendblob, blockblob.

fields.name: blob_uri_length
fields.description: Set the length of the generated blob URI used when creating and uploading objects to Azure Blob Storage.

fields.name: buffer_dir
fields.description: Specifies the location of directory where the buffered data will be stored.

fields.name: buffer_file_delete_early
fields.description: Whether to delete the buffered file early after successful blob creation.

fields.name: buffering_enabled
fields.description: Enable buffering into disk before ingesting into Azure Blob.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Sets payload compression in network transfer. Supported values: gzip, zstd.

fields.name: compress_blob
fields.description: Enables compression in the final blockblob file. When enabled without compress, it uses GZIP; if compress is also set, it inherits that codec. This option isn't compatible when blob_type = appendblob. Fluent Bit returns a configuration error and fails to start.

fields.name: configuration_endpoint_bearer_token
fields.description: Bearer token for the configuration endpoint.

fields.name: configuration_endpoint_password
fields.description: Basic authentication password for the configuration endpoint.

fields.name: configuration_endpoint_url
fields.description: Configuration endpoint URL.

fields.name: configuration_endpoint_username
fields.description: Basic authentication username for the configuration endpoint.

fields.name: container_name
fields.description: Name of the container that will contain the blobs.

fields.name: database_file
fields.description: Absolute path to a database file used to store blob file contexts.

fields.name: date_key
fields.description: Key name used to store the record timestamp.

fields.name: delete_on_max_upload_error
fields.description: Whether to delete the buffer file on maximum upload errors.

fields.name: emulator_mode
fields.description: To send data to an Azure emulator service like Azurite, enable this option to format the requests in the expected format.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: When using an emulator, this option lets you specify the absolute HTTP address of such service. For example, http://127.0.0.1:10000.

fields.name: file_delivery_attempt_limit
fields.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts for a file.

fields.name: io_timeout
fields.description: HTTP IO timeout.

fields.name: part_delivery_attempt_limit
fields.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts for a file part.

fields.name: part_size
fields.description: Size of each part when uploading blob files.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Optional. The path to store your blobs. If your blob name is myblob, specify subdirectories for storage using path. For example, setting path to /logs/kubernetes will store your blob in /logs/kubernetes/myblob.

fields.name: sas_token
fields.description: Specify the Azure Storage shared access signatures to authenticate against the service. This configuration property is mandatory when auth_type is sas.

fields.name: scheduler_max_retries
fields.description: Maximum number of retries for the scheduler send blob.

fields.name: shared_key
fields.description: Specify the Azure Storage Shared Key to authenticate against the service. This configuration property is mandatory when auth_type is key.

fields.name: store_dir_limit_size
fields.description: Set the max size of the buffer directory.

fields.name: tls
fields.description: Enable or disable TLS encryption. Azure service requires this to be set to on.

fields.name: unify_tag
fields.description: Whether to create a single buffer file when buffering mode is enabled.

fields.name: upload_file_size
fields.description: Specifies the size of files to be uploaded in MB.

fields.name: upload_part_freshness_limit
fields.description: Maximum lifespan of an uncommitted file part.

fields.name: upload_parts_timeout
fields.description: Timeout for uploading parts of a blob file.

fields.name: upload_timeout
fields.description: Optional. Specify a timeout for uploads. Fluent Bit will start ingesting buffer files which have been created more than x minutes and haven't reached upload_file_size limit yet.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Azure Blob.
